annotations.text:
Three directions for the Vulcx hero, all on the extracted tokens.

Clash Display is Fontshare, not Google Fonts — these artboards render Space Grotesk as its stand-in. Self-host Clash in the real build.

AXIS: developer credibility.
The response IS the hero. Fogo's ember horizon, mono-forward.

Tradeoff: reads as an API product, not a protocol — weak if you also want end-user traffic.

AXIS: show the mechanism.
The split route is the hero — the one thing a single-DEX swap UI cannot show.

Tradeoff: the visual needs real route data to stay honest, so it is the most work to build and keep true.

AXIS: proof by numbers, MetaMask-style contrast.
Inverts the palette — mint ground, ember as a single block. Leads with the fee argument.

Tradeoff: loudest and least Fogo-native; the inversion competes with the chain's own site.
